method: Offline ordinary-memory kernels extracted from profiled guest code. Native Step exact-state oracle; native Run full-budget check. Browser 500k warmup then 8 alternating-order trials of 5M calls; no JS call per kernel. No whole-game speedup claim.

limitations: Only two kernels, one a seven-instruction prefix, from Snakes. Synthetic seeded memory, not recorded live register states.
Aligned permitted ordinary-memory path only; faults/aliases/code writes not exercised by kernel timing. Flat and budget variants deliberately weaken semantics and are never deployed.
No-op native terminal differs from math return. Do not subtract minimal-call time as a constant or extrapolate per-Run throughput to Qt block linking.
Check-removal effects interact and change compiler lowering. Cannot add individual savings or assign them as whole-game fractions.
Static code size, branches and stack operands include cold code, not executed counts.
Native fastmem experiment is fixture-only with accesses confined to allocated memory.
Inspection timings are excluded. A truncated final jitdump record was ignored.
Precise exit-flush prototype rejected after kernel timings, not endorsed by a full-game or fault/alias regression test.
